The '''Procurement Panel''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Naval Subcommittee]] that oversaw the appropriations for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

Near the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Gopple]] and [[V'troren Tara]] sat on the panel, and brought [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jerjerrod (admiral)|Jerjerrod]] before it to testify on critical and vituperative remarks he had made relating to the panel's policies.
